articles.title: David Attenborough Returns to Guide Viewers Through BBC's Blue Planet III
articles.summary: One of the world's most famous nature programmes is back! Blue Planet III, a brand-new ocean documentary series made by the BBC, began airing on BBC One on 1 November 2026. The show takes viewers on an amazing journey deep into the world's oceans, exploring the creatures and environments that live there. Sir David Attenborough, who is well known for narrating many celebrated nature programmes, has returned to lend his voice to this new series. The programme is also supported by broadcasters from Germany, France, and Greece, making it a truly global production that shines a light on the importance of protecting our seas.

lv1: Who is the narrator of Blue Planet III? (《藍色星球III》的旁白是誰？)
On which TV channel did Blue Planet III first appear? (《藍色星球III》首先在哪個電視頻道播出？)
lv2: Why do you think it is important for a nature programme like Blue Planet III to be made together by broadcasters from many different countries? (你認為像《藍色星球III》這樣的自然節目由多國廣播機構共同製作，為什麼重要？)
How might a documentary about oceans help people understand the need to protect the environment? (一部關於海洋的紀錄片如何幫助人們了解保護環境的必要性？)
lv3: Some people argue that nature documentaries make oceans look beautiful but do not do enough to show the real threats they face. Do you agree? What more could such programmes do to inspire action? (有人認為自然紀錄片把海洋拍得很美麗，卻沒有充分展示海洋所面臨的真正威脅。你同意嗎？這類節目還能做什麼來激勵行動？)

Sir David Attenborough is over 100 years old and continues to work on major nature projects. What does his continued involvement say about the role of older generations in raising awareness about the environment, and should younger voices be given more prominence in such productions? (艾登堡爵士已逾百歲，仍參與重大自然項目。他的持續參與對年長一代在提升環保意識方面有何意義？製作中是否應給予年輕聲音更多空間？)

articles.title: Damage to US Military Bases in the Middle East Raises Global Security Concerns
articles.summary: Reports published on 3 November 2026 reveal that more than 115 missile and drone attacks have struck around 26 United States military bases across the Middle East in recent weeks. The strikes are linked to ongoing conflict involving Iran and have caused serious damage to expensive defence equipment, including radar systems worth hundreds of millions of dollars. Leaders and analysts around the world are closely watching the situation, as it affects energy supplies, trade routes, and the safety of millions of people living and working in the region. The conflict is a reminder of how wars in one part of the world can have wide effects on everyone.

lv1: How many US military bases were reported to have been hit by missile or drone attacks? (據報有多少個美國軍事基地遭導彈或無人機攻擊？)
In which region are these military bases located? (這些軍事基地位於哪個地區？)
lv2: Why might damage to military radar systems be particularly serious during a conflict? (在衝突期間，軍事雷達系統受損為何特別嚴重？)
How can a conflict in the Middle East affect people living in faraway places like Hong Kong or Asia? (中東地區的衝突如何影響香港或亞洲等遙遠地方的人們？)
lv3: When governments spend billions of dollars on military equipment that gets destroyed in conflict, who ultimately pays the cost, and is this a fair use of public money? (當政府花費數十億美元購買的軍事裝備在衝突中被摧毀，最終由誰承擔代價？這樣使用公共資金公平嗎？)

Some argue that international organisations should do more to prevent conflicts before they escalate to the point of military strikes. What powers should such organisations have, and what are the limits of their authority? (有人認為國際組織應該在衝突升級至軍事打擊之前採取更多行動加以預防。這些組織應擁有哪些權力，其權力又有何限制？)

articles.title: 國際私法機構UNIDROIT在港設亞太辦事處 助推動商事法規全球統一
articles.summary: 總部設於意大利羅馬、擁有65個成員國的國際統一私法協會（UNIDROIT），近日宣布在香港開設亞太地區聯絡辦事處。香港法律周同期舉行，中國商務部官員出席致辭，指多個重要私法國際機構相繼在港落戶，充分體現香港在國際法律舞台上備受認可的地位。UNIDROIT致力推動各國商業法律規則走向統一，方便企業跨境交易。香港作為連接中國與國際的樞紐，在促進全球法律合作方面擔當重要角色。

lv1: UNIDROIT在香港設立的是什麼類型的辦事處？
lv2: 為什麼國際法律機構選擇在香港設立辦事處，而不是其他亞洲城市？
推動各國商業法律走向統一，對做生意的人有什麼好處？
lv3: 香港一直以「一國兩制」下的普通法體系作為吸引國際法律機構的優勢。隨著香港法律環境的轉變，這種優勢是否仍然存在？請從不同角度討論。
當國際機構在一個城市設立辦事處，這個城市的市民能從中得到什麼實質利益？又可能面對什麼挑戰？

articles.title: 網上假旅行社專頁泛濫 市民報團隨時變財散人空 警方呼籲善用視伏器查真假
articles.summary: 近期香港出現大量仿冒正規旅行社的虛假社交媒體專頁，以低至數百元的吸引套票引誘市民網上報名，部分受害者付款後才發現根本聯絡不上對方，血本無歸。警方提醒市民，可善用「視伏器」平台核實商戶真偽，並建議盡量親身前往實體旅行社辦理報團手續。業界亦指出，認准社交平台的「藍剔」認證標記，有助辨別專頁是否屬於正規機構，避免墮入騙局。

lv1: 騙徒用什麼方法吸引市民到假旅行社專頁報名？
警方建議市民使用哪個工具來辨別商戶真偽？
lv2: 為什麼在網上購買旅遊套票比在實體店購買風險更高？
社交媒體平台可以採取哪些措施，減少假冒商戶專頁的出現？
lv3: 有人認為，網上騙案頻繁發生，責任不只在於騙徒，平台公司和政府監管機構同樣應該負責。你認同這個看法嗎？各方應如何分擔責任？
隨著人工智能技術進步，製作「倒模級」假冒網頁變得愈來愈容易。社會應如何在鼓勵科技創新的同時，保護市民免受此類欺詐的侵害？
